answer_1.quote: In this work, we introduce a new multi-parallel corpus from the European Central Bank (ECB), consisting of financial (macroeconomics) articles published exclusively in 2024, translated and aligned across 22 European languages. Using this resource, we can evaluate how MT systems handle the complexities of financial translation...
datasets: multi-parallel corpus from the European Central Bank (ECB)

answer_2.quote: Metrics We employ CHRF++, a character-level metric based on n-gram overlap between system output and reference translations, and COMET, a semantic-based metric that leverages pretrained multilingual representations to score translation quality.
